newsitem.title: UK: UK analyst puts Ivory cocoa crop at 1.045 mln T.
newsitem.headline: UK analyst puts Ivory cocoa crop at 1.045 mln T.

text.p: A UK-based commodity analyst has slightly raised its forecast of the 1996/97 Ivorian cocoa crop to a total of 1.045 million tonnes.
The forecast, completed at the end of last week, was based on arrival figures of the main crop of around 880,000 tonnes by the end of February.
The arrival figures fit in more with the pattern of last season than the previous season, said a company official.
Ivorian Commodities Minister Guy-Alain Gauze said earlier this week that the total crop would be less than one million tonnes.
According to Ivorian industry sources, arrivals at ports had already reached between 920,000 and 960,000 tonnes by March 7. -- Clelia Oziel, London newsroom +44 171 542 8072
